scope: Replace only the invalid original D3 MS 32 primary plus 8 repeat pairs.
root_cause: The original shared context query included supporter-authored nonredundancy metacues, allowing the experimental manipulation to steer MS lexical retrieval toward unrelated generic summaries.

shared_internal_external_query_contract.decision_timing: after concrete candidate discovery and before injection or generation

replacement_design.backgrounds: all eight MP x ME x RS combinations, four users each

measurement_boundary.retrieval_qualification: Objective construction-grounded audit; no psychological quality rating required.
measurement_boundary.component_effect: One blinded same-state response-quality decision remains necessary because correct retrieval does not establish beneficial injection.
measurement_boundary.risk: Only MS-on material wins receive the minimal interaction-and-grounding risk screen.
measurement_boundary.cost: Use exact incremental token accounting after the quality and risk gates.

merge_rule: Formal D3 equals original RS/MP/ME 120 pairs plus replacement MS 40 pairs; never append both old and replacement MS.
stop_rules: Do not change RS, MP, ME, the strategy bank, generator, or prompt compiler in this repair.
Do not use external outcomes, existing D3 response outcomes, or human labels to construct or select the replacement states.
Do not tune BGE, Qwen, thresholds, seeds, or regularization on the replacement outcomes.
If the replacement MS head fails the frozen grouped-OOF gate, report failure instead of adding another data wave in V1.5.
